faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.sub: Find answers to the most common questions. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us.

items.q: What types of cars can you import?
items.a: We import all types of cars — new, used, lightly damaged, or total loss write-offs. We specialize in American brands but also import Japanese, European and any other brand available at US auctions.

items.q: How much does car import cost?
items.a: Costs depend on the car price, type of transport, and customs fees. Typically transport and customs costs range between €1,500 and €3,500. We provide a full calculation upfront with no hidden fees.

items.q: How long does the process take?
items.a: Typically from purchase to receiving your car takes 6–8 weeks. Cargo ship to Rotterdam — 3–4 weeks, customs clearance — 1–2 weeks, transport to Bulgaria — 3–5 days.
Yes, we provide you with a container tracking number. We will keep you informed at every key step — purchase, loading, departure, arrival in Rotterdam, customs, delivery to you.
You receive the US Title (ownership document), Bill of Lading, CMR, customs declarations, and a COC certificate for EU registration. Everything needed for registration.
Yes, we specialize in damaged cars from Copart and IAAI. Many have only cosmetic or minor damage and are excellent value. We can arrange repairs upon arrival if desired.

items.q: Do you work with European clients outside Bulgaria?
items.a: Yes, we import cars for clients throughout Europe. Rotterdam is our central hub from where we distribute to Romania, Germany, Austria, France and any other EU country.
